intro: Reusable groups of users you can target from any flag.

readOnly.title: Read-only access
readOnly.create: Viewers cannot create segments. Ask an editor or owner.
readOnly.edit: Viewers can inspect segments but not change them. Ask an editor or owner.

empty.title: No segments yet
empty.description: Define a group once, for example beta testers or internal staff, and target it from any flag rule.

key.hintEdit: The key is referenced by flag rules and cannot be changed.
key.hintCreate: Letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-". Flag rules reference the segment by this key.

membership.description: A user belongs to this segment when they match the conditions below.

conditions.empty: No conditions yet. A segment without conditions matches nobody.

deleteDialog.title: Delete segment “{{key}}”?
deleteDialog.inUseDescription_one: {{count}} flag rule references this segment. Remove the segment condition from this rule first, then delete it.
deleteDialog.inUseDescription_other: {{count}} flag rules reference this segment. Remove the segment condition from these rules first, then delete it.
deleteDialog.description: This cannot be undone. No flag rules reference this segment.

usages.title: Used by
usages.empty: No flag rules reference this segment yet.
